description: This file defines utility functions for handling errors, specifically to determine if an exception is transient and should be retried. It imports various modules and external exceptions pertinent to network, database, and Jira API errors, and contains a function 'is_transient_error' that encapsulates this logic.

methods.name: bool is_transient_error(exc: Exception)
methods.description: Determines whether an exception is considered transient and should be retried based on its type.
